note: Rawbank's standard tariff (15 January 2026, before VAT): a private customer's current account, in francs or dollars, comes in a package; the Pack Eco (current account, Visa Classic card, SMS alerts, Illicocash, online banking) costs 5 dollars a month, charged in dollars as the bank prices it. The civil servants' and students' packs aren't open to everyone.
